description: This file contains the implementation of the PSR-7 HTTP Request object, including methods for managing request data, headers, URI, and request target according to the PSR-7 standard in PHP.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Implementation of the PSR-7 HTTP Request interface, supporting construction, header management, URI handling, and request target configuration.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns the request target, defaulting to the path and query of the URI if not explicitly set.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target after validating it.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP method.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI object associated with the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI, optionally preserving the Host header.

methods.name: updateHostFromUri
methods.description: Internal method to update the Host header based on the URI's host and port.

methods.name: assertMethod
methods.description: Internal method to validate that the HTTP method is a non-empty string.
